text.tspan: == converts before it compares. === never converts. Use === and convert on purpose.
Rule of thumb: always ===. When you DO want a conversion, write it out: Number(x), String(x), Boolean(x).
The one accepted use of == is x == null, which is true for exactly null and undefined and nothing else.
